what: Post-commit follow-up still fail-closes on carryover porcelain
scenario_or_breakage: After the guard skips carryover and the round commit succeeds, carryover paths remain in `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no`, so the #3209 block still runs and line 574 emits `CODER_STATUS=failed` / return 2 — the #3272 scenario still fails despite the pre-commit guard fix
suggested_fix: In the same change, treat carryover like the guard (skip follow-up when tracked dirt is carryover-only; at 574 fail only on non-carryover tracked dirt via `path_is_pre_coder_carryover`). Update `review-and-fix.md:56-57` and exit-code text to match warn-and-continue carryover. Add a harness case that commits coder delta with snapshotted carryover and asserts exit 0 / `CODER_STATUS=applied`.
